title: DNS names on the wire
hints: For decoding, keep two positions: where you are reading now, and (the first time you follow a pointer) where the caller should continue, which is just after that first pointer. Count pointers followed and give up after 20.

"Big-endian" (lesson 2.03 covers it fully) means the most significant byte comes first. To write a 16-bit value `v` that way, push `static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> 8)` and then `static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v & 0xFF)`: the id `0xBEEF` becomes the bytes `BE EF`.
